Who We Are

Three friends. One piano trio. From Roma to Beijing.

We’re Ginevra, Francesca and Greta — classical, but make it now. Ensemble of the Year for Le Dimore del Quartetto, debut album on Brilliant Classics, partners with Pirastro and Steinway & Sons Milano.

Special Projects

Beyond the concert hall

Beyond the stage, we collaborate with composers, schools and brands to bring chamber music into rooms where it doesn’t usually go.

Cross-disciplinary · with Guido Barbieri

Beethoven & Goya

An annual cycle dedicated to Art and Music, developed with internationally renowned musicologist and critic Guido Barbieri. The inaugural project pairs Ludwig van Beethoven with Francisco Goya, opening a series of cross-disciplinary collaborations.

Multi-concert series

Schumann Project

An original project devoted to the chamber music of Robert Schumann, structured as a multi-concert series with various chamber formations — built with members of the Quartetto di Cremona, Trio di Parma and leading communicators who introduce the audience to the listening experience. Following its critical and public success, future editions on Beethoven and Schubert are in preparation.

Contemporary Music

New Works for the Trio

Active commitment to the promotion of contemporary music, in close collaboration with leading composers including Domenico Turi, Fabio Massimo Capogrosso and Silvia Colasanti.

Broadcast

Rai Radio 3 — NextGeneration

Featured in the Rai Radio 3 programmes NextGeneration and La Stanza della Musica, culminating in a live radio broadcast concert from the Cappella Paolina del Quirinale.

Programme

Communicators & Listening

Working with leading communicators — including Guido Barbieri — the Trio designs concerts that introduce the audience to the listening experience, opening up the chamber-music repertoire for new listeners.

Talent & Mentorship

Giovani Talenti Italiani nel Mondo

Selected by the Fondazione Accademia Musicale Chigiana for the project Giovani Talenti Musicali Italiani nel Mondo, in collaboration with the Ministero degli Affari Esteri and CIDIM — a programme that brings young Italian ensembles to international stages.

Young Artist Program · since 2025

Pirastro

The Trio is supported by Pirastro through the Pirastro Young Artist Program.

Piano Partner · since 2025

Steinway & Sons Milano

Official piano partner: Steinway & Sons Milano supports the Trio’s concert and recording activity.

Cultural Partner

Le Dimore del Quartetto

Selected by Simone Gramaglia in 2021 to join Le Dimore del Quartetto, the Trio was awarded Ensemble of the Year 2023, chosen among more than 92 ensembles worldwide.

Broadcaster

Rai Radio 3

A close collaboration with Rai Radio 3 — episodes of NextGeneration and La Stanza della Musica, plus a live broadcast from the Cappella Paolina del Quirinale.

Monographic · Italian Composer

The Trio’s debut album for Brilliant Classics, dedicated to the chamber music of Italian composer Ildebrando Pizzetti.
